# synthetic: f-strings whose holes are fixed in code
COLS = ("id", "name")
TABLES = ("item", "box")


def fine(cur, ids, limit):
    cur.execute(f"SELECT {', '.join(COLS)} FROM item WHERE id IN ({', '.join('?' * len(ids))})", ids)
    cur.execute(f"SELECT id FROM item LIMIT {int(limit)}")
    for t in TABLES:
        cur.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {t}")
    cur.execute("SELECT id FROM item WHERE name = ?", ("a",))
